name: zip_code
description: San Francisco ZIP code. Primary key of this table and the conformed key joining sales, market demand, candidate sites and feedback.

name: neighborhood_name
description: Representative neighbourhood label; ZIPs and neighbourhoods are not one-to-one. Presentation only; never join on this.

name: city
description: City. Always 'San Francisco' in this scenario.

name: latitude
description: Representative neighbourhood latitude, WGS84. Not a ZIP centroid or boundary.

name: median_household_income
description: Synthetic median annual household income in USD; illustrative, not a Census estimate.

name: total_population
description: Synthetic resident population of the ZIP; illustrative, not a Census estimate.

name: median_age
description: Synthetic median resident age in years.

name: morning_foot_traffic_index
description: Relative pedestrian activity 06:00-11:00, indexed 0-100. Modelled, not measured. A static average over the whole period: this table keeps no time series.

name: weekend_foot_traffic_index
description: Relative pedestrian activity on Saturday and Sunday, indexed 0-100.

name: foot_traffic_score
description: Unweighted mean of the morning, evening and weekend indices. 0-100, higher is busier. Derived: do not treat it as an independent measurement alongside its three components.
